none: PAS NLM-ECC6B7: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North East Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), possibly Siscia mint Two Victories issue of 347-348, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Youthful bust laureate cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: possibly [---]PF AVG. Reverse description: Two Victories standing facing each other holding wreaths; probably a letter M between Victories. Reverse inscription: [VICTORIAE] DDAVGGQ N. In exergue: SIS. Diameter: 14.9mm, Weight: 1.22gms. die axis: 6
